decisions.reason: Adds independently distilled/architecture-searched stereo disparity from rectified paired images; v77 has no identified stereo disparity specialist. Hunyuan3D generates assets, SAM3 segments masks, RoboTracker tracks temporal points; none directly estimates dense metric geometry. Publisher ~14.6M parameters, exact full tensor census unresolved.
decisions.quality_positive: CVPR 2026 family paper reports >10x speed vs FoundationStereo with close zero-shot accuracy; independent arXiv:2610.27199 reports Fast-FoundationStereo family 0.33% AbsRel at a higher compute point on Jetson AGX Orin/Middlebury 2014, not verified for this exact commercial BP2 checkpoint.
decisions.quality_negative: Authors distinguish faster from more accurate research checkpoints; independent study found classical libSGM competitive (0.73% AbsRel at 25ms at its real-time operating point). Different operating points and exact checkpoint unresolved; no matched owner test, no universal superiority or safety-critical reliability.
